en: Fixed rules symlinked into `.claude/rules` from outside the project being skipped without ever showing the external-imports approval prompt; a `.claude` directory symlinked from outside the project now asks for the same approval
zh: 修复了从项目外部符号链接到 `.claude/rules` 的规则被跳过且从未显示外部导入批准提示的问题；现在从项目外部符号链接的 `.claude` 目录也会请求同样的批准
